info.title: speedrun talent network API
info.description: Public, read-only API over the a16z speedrun talent network jobs board: live open roles across the speedrun and a16z portfolios (plus an opt-in wider startup universe), hiring companies, curated collections, and aggregate hiring stats. No authentication for reads. Every response is JSON and edge-cached for 1-5 minutes. Please pass ?source=<your-integration> so we can see agent traffic. Data refreshes continuously from each company’s live job board.

get.description: Full-text + faceted search over every live role, with the exact vocabulary the site’s /jobs board uses. Facet counts are computed against the query so the numbers never lie. Default scope covers the speedrun + a16z portfolios; pass scope=speedrun to narrow to speedrun portfolio companies only, or scope=everywhere to include the wider startup universe (when the scope machinery is live, responses carry scope and beyond_portfolio).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text query (title, company, location; synonyms like ml/swe/nyc expand).

parameters.name: fn
parameters.description: Function filter, comma-separated: engineering, research, product, design, sales, marketing, operations, other. While classified crafts are enabled the vocabulary widens to data, growth, customer, finance, legal, people, business_development, strategy, executive, hardware_manufacturing as well (read facets.fn for the live set; the original eight values keep working).

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Specialty filter, comma-separated slugs, meaningful with exactly ONE fn value (specialties are scoped to a craft). Read facets.spec for the live vocabulary under the selected craft. Ignored while classified crafts are disabled.

parameters.name: sen
parameters.description: Seniority filter, comma-separated: founding, exec, staff, senior, junior, intern, plus _ for roles with no stated level (facets.senUnspecified counts them). While the classified level ladder is enabled these values are remapped onto lvl (founding -> founder, exec -> director/vp/c_level, staff -> staff_principal, junior -> junior/new_grad).

parameters.name: lvl
parameters.description: Classified level filter, comma-separated, ladder order: intern, new_grad, junior, mid, senior, staff_principal, lead_manager, director, vp, c_level, founder, plus _ for roles with no level label (facets.lvlUnspecified counts them). Live counts in facets.lvl. Ignored while classified crafts are disabled.

parameters.name: yoe
parameters.description: Classified minimum-experience band, comma-separated, band order: 0 (none required), under_1, 1_2, 3_5, 6_9, 10_14, 15_plus, plus _ for roles with no experience label (facets.yoeUnspecified counts them). Live counts in facets.yoe. Ignored while classified crafts are disabled.

parameters.name: eng
parameters.description: Classified engagement type, comma-separated: full_time, part_time, contract, internship, cofounder, advisor, plus _ for roles with no engagement label (facets.engUnspecified counts them). Live counts in facets.eng. Complements emp, the source ATS field. Ignored while classified crafts are disabled.

parameters.name: founding
parameters.description: Set to 1 to keep only roles classified as founding roles (founding team, first N hires). facets.founding counts them; roles with no label yet never match (facets.foundingUnspecified). Ignored while classified crafts are disabled.

parameters.name: ai
parameters.description: Set to 1 to keep only roles classified as AI-native (the day job is building with or on models). facets.aiRole counts them; unlabelled roles never match (facets.aiUnspecified). Ignored while classified crafts are disabled.

parameters.name: emp
parameters.description: Employment type, comma-separated: FullTime, PartTime, Intern, Contract, Temporary.

parameters.name: loc
parameters.description: Location filter: comma-separated city values (see facets.loc for live vocabulary); special value "remote".

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: Set to 1 to filter to remote-open roles. Alias of wp=remote.

parameters.name: wp
parameters.description: Workplace filter, comma-separated (OR within the group): remote (roles open to remote candidates), hybrid, onsite. Live counts in facets.workplace.

parameters.name: metro
parameters.description: Metro filter, comma-separated keys, at most 5: sf, nyc, la, sv, dc, chi, sea, bos, aus, lon, oc, dal, atl, tor, sd. Each expands to its cities server-side and ORs with loc/remote. Live counts in facets.metro.

parameters.name: comp
parameters.description: Minimum annual comp in USD: matches roles whose posted ANNUAL band reaches this number (comp_max >= comp). Bands posted in non-annual periods (comp_period = hour/month/week/day) never match.

parameters.name: comp_max
parameters.description: Maximum annual comp in USD: matches roles whose posted ANNUAL band starts at or below this number (comp_min <= comp_max). Combine with comp for a range.

parameters.name: comp_any
parameters.description: Set to 1 alongside comp and/or comp_max to ALSO include roles without posted comp (by default a pay floor or ceiling hides them; facets.compHidden reports how many).

parameters.name: posted
parameters.description: Posted-date preset: 24h, 7d or 30d (published in the past day / week / month; the cutoff is rounded to the hour). Live counts in facets.posted.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Company stage filter, comma-separated (see facets.stage for the live vocabulary, e.g. seed, series_a, series_b, growth).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Company size filter, comma-separated employee bands: 1_10, 11_50, 51_200, 201_500, 501_1000, 1001_5000, 5000_plus (facets.size for live counts; facets.sizeUnspecified counts roles at companies with no size label). Ignored while company facets are disabled.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Company industry filter, comma-separated slugs of LinkedIn industry names (e.g. computer_software, financial_services, hospital_health_care); facets.industry carries the live top-24 vocabulary. Ignored while company facets are disabled.

parameters.name: lab
parameters.description: Set to 1 to keep only roles at frontier AI labs (facets.frontierLab counts them). Ignored while company facets are disabled.

parameters.name: bigtech
parameters.description: Set to 1 to keep only roles at big tech companies (facets.bigTech counts them). Ignored while company facets are disabled.

parameters.name: portfolio
parameters.description: Relationship tier, comma-separated: speedrun, a16z, market.

parameters.name: cohort
parameters.description: speedrun cohort tag(s), comma-separated (e.g. SR007).

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Exact company key.

parameters.name: stealth
parameters.description: 'only' = stealth roles only; 'hide' = hide stealth roles.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: 'speedrun' narrows results to speedrun portfolio companies only; 'everywhere' widens them past the portfolio into the startup universe (both flag-gated server-side; inert while the scope machinery is dark).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: rel (relevance, default with q) | new (newest) | comp (highest posted comp).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 0-based page number, 50 items per page.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional attribution tag for your integration (e.g. your agent or app name). Echoed back in the response.

200.description: Matching jobs, facet counts, and pagination metadata.

scope.description: Present only while the universe scope is live.

beyond_portfolio.description: Roles matching the same filters, past the scope boundary. In portfolio scope: universe-tier roles beyond the portfolio. In speedrun scope: roles beyond speedrun within the a16z portfolio. In everywhere scope: the count of universe-tier roles ALREADY included in the results (informational — never add it to total). Present only while the universe scope is live.

400.description: Bad request (e.g. too many filter values).

get.description: The same aggregates the /network page renders: open-role and hiring-company counts, demand mix by function, posted pay-band midpoints by function (p25/median/p75, annual USD), remote share, top hiring locations, and the portfolio split.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional attribution tag for your integration (e.g. your agent or app name). Echoed back in the response.

comp_posted.description: Roles with a posted pay band.

Job.description: One open role, exactly as the board lists it. Stealth roles are masked (company "Stealth", no company link) before they ever leave the query layer.

id.description: Job UUID. The first 8 hex characters also work as a lookup key.

company.description: Company display key; "Stealth" when the role is masked.

company_url.description: Absolute /companies profile URL, when one exists.

url.description: Canonical absolute job URL on speedrun-talent-network.com. Link users here.

function.description: engineering | research | product | design | sales | marketing | operations | other.

seniority.description: founding | exec | staff | senior | junior | intern (null = unclassified).

comp_min.description: Posted pay band floor, in comp_period units (annual when comp_period is null).

comp_max.description: Posted pay band ceiling, in comp_period units (annual when comp_period is null).

comp_period.description: Pay period the source posted. null = annual by convention. Non-annual bands are display-only: they never match the comp filter and are excluded from comp facet counts.

cohort.description: speedrun cohort tag (e.g. SR007) when the company is a speedrun portfolio company.

tier.description: Relationship tier. Present only while the startup-universe scope or the wider-market tier is live. 'market' = wider-market early-career org, not an a16z portfolio company.

status.description: closed = the role existed but is no longer open; only id/title/company/url remain meaningful and apply/description are null.

comp_summary.description: Human-readable posted pay summary, when the company posted one.

comp_period.description: Pay period the source posted; null = annual by convention.

apply.description: How to apply. kind 'onsite' = the candidate applies on the job URL itself (no redirect); 'external' = the URL hands off to the company's own careers page.

description_text.description: Plain-text job description (HTML stripped), capped at 15,000 characters. Null on closed roles.

labels.description: Classified labels for the role as display strings (function, specialty, seniority, minimum experience band, workplace, engagement, founding-role and AI-native flags). Present only while classified labels are enabled on the board; null when the role has no classification yet. A field the classifier could not decide reads null.

tier.description: 'speedrun' or 'a16z' (portfolio tiers), or 'market' (wider-market org, listed only while that tier is live).

labels.description: Company detail only: classified company labels as display strings (stage, size band, business model, industry as LinkedIn's industry name, frontier-lab / big-tech / AI-native / hardware flags). Present only while company facets are enabled; null when the company has no classification yet. A field the classifier could not decide reads null.

portfolio_members.description: Members in the a16z portfolio (speedrun + a16z tiers).

Facets.description: Live counts per filter value, computed against the current query (each group excludes its own filter so the numbers stay honest).

loc.description: Top cities; the first entry is the "remote" pseudo-value.

workplace.description: Workplace counts: "remote" first (roles open to remote candidates), then hybrid and onsite.

metro.description: Metro counts keyed by the metro parameter vocabulary (sf, nyc, la, ...).

stage.description: Company stage counts (the stage parameter vocabulary).

posted.description: Roles published inside each posted preset window.

senUnspecified.description: Roles with no stated seniority (sen=_ selects them).

spec.description: Specialty counts under the ONE selected craft (empty otherwise). Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

lvl.description: Classified level counts (the lvl parameter vocabulary). Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

fnUnspecified.description: Roles with no craft label yet. Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

lvlUnspecified.description: Roles with no level label yet (lvl=_ selects them). Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

yoe.description: Classified minimum-experience band counts (the yoe parameter vocabulary). Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

eng.description: Classified engagement type counts (the eng parameter vocabulary). Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

yoeUnspecified.description: Roles with no experience label yet (yoe=_ selects them). Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

engUnspecified.description: Roles with no engagement label yet (eng=_ selects them). Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

founding.description: Roles classified as founding roles (founding=1 selects them), counted with every other filter applied. Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

aiRole.description: Roles classified as AI-native (ai=1 selects them), counted with every other filter applied. Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

foundingUnspecified.description: Roles with no founding-role label yet. Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

aiUnspecified.description: Roles with no AI-native label yet. Present only while classified crafts are enabled.

size.description: Company size band counts (the size parameter vocabulary). Present only while company facets are enabled.

industry.description: Top-24 company industry counts (the industry parameter vocabulary; v is the slug of a LinkedIn industry name, e.g. hospital_health_care = Hospital & Health Care). Present only while company facets are enabled.

stageUnspecified.description: Roles at companies with no stage label. Present only while company facets are enabled.

sizeUnspecified.description: Roles at companies with no size label. Present only while company facets are enabled.

industryUnspecified.description: Roles at companies with no industry label. Present only while company facets are enabled.

frontierLab.description: Roles at frontier AI labs (lab=1 selects them). Present only while company facets are enabled.

bigTech.description: Roles at big tech companies (bigtech=1 selects them). Present only while company facets are enabled.
